caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with three large lower drawers and a top compartment featuring a drop-front panel, possibly a writing desk. The chest is rendered in shades of brown with darker wood grain patterns visible throughout, and each drawer is fitted with two round, ornate metal handles colored grayish-silver. The top compartment has a single small keyhole. The chest sits on bracket feet, and the perspective shows both the front and the right side. Above the chest, there is a rectangular metallic plaque with engraved text, bordered by a rough, brown wooden backing. To the right of the plaque, there is a detailed, line-drawn oval escutcheon with a decorative motif, likely indicating the design of the drawer handles. Below the chest, there is another rectangular label that appears to be made from paper, bordered on two sides by fragments of wood, with ornate text and floral decoration. The background of the drawing is an off-white or light beige color, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Chest
